from rutis import define_plugin


class UsageError(Exception):
    code = "usage"


async def apply(ctx, config):
    notes = ctx.use("notes")

    async def shout(args):
        if not args:
            raise UsageError("say what to shout: jot shout <text>")
        text = " ".join(args).upper()
        await notes.add(text)
        return f"added: {text}"

    await ctx.use("commands").register("shout", shout)


plugin = define_plugin(apply, inject=["notes", "commands"])

import asyncio
import unittest

from rutis import define_plugin
from rutis.testing import Bus, load


def greeter_apply(ctx, config):
    # None or False is "no result": serial asks the next listener
    ctx.on("greeting/pick", lambda lang: "Hej" if lang == "sv" else None)

    class Greeter:
        async def hello(self, name, lang):
            word = await ctx.serial("greeting/pick", lang) or "Hello"
            # terminal: the innermost end of the chain, given the event's arguments
            text = await ctx.waterfall("greeting/format", f"{word}, {name}", terminal=lambda text: text)
            ctx.emit("greeting/said", name)      # returns at once, waits for no listener
            return text

    ctx.provide("greeter", Greeter())


greeter = define_plugin(greeter_apply)
said = []


def shout_apply(ctx, config):
    async def exclaim(text, next):           # a waterfall listener gets next last
        return f"{await next()}!"

    ctx.on("greeting/format", exclaim)
    ctx.on("greeting/said", said.append)


shout = define_plugin(shout_apply)


class Events(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_plugins_hear_each_other(self):
        async def go():
            bus = Bus()                          # plugins on one bus hear each other
            async with load(greeter, bus=bus, id="greeter") as t, load(shout, bus=bus, id="shout"):
                self.assertEqual(await t.service("greeter").hello("Ada", "sv"), "Hej, Ada!")
                self.assertEqual(await t.service("greeter").hello("Bo", "en"), "Hello, Bo!")
                self.assertEqual(await t.serial("greeting/pick", "sv"), "Hej")  # the test can emit too
                self.assertEqual(said, ["Ada", "Bo"])    # emits go through the host: delivered once the serial after them is back

        asyncio.run(go())

import unittest

from rutis import define_plugin
from rutis.testing import Bus, load


def greeter_apply(ctx, config):
    # 返回 None 或 False 是"没有结果"，serial 接着问下一个监听器
    ctx.on("greeting/pick", lambda lang: "Hej" if lang == "sv" else None)

    class Greeter:
        async def hello(self, name, lang):
            word = await ctx.serial("greeting/pick", lang) or "Hello"
            # terminal：链的最里面，收到事件参数
            text = await ctx.waterfall("greeting/format", f"{word}, {name}", terminal=lambda text: text)
            ctx.emit("greeting/said", name)      # 立即返回，不等监听器
            return text

    ctx.provide("greeter", Greeter())


greeter = define_plugin(greeter_apply)
said = []


def shout_apply(ctx, config):
    async def exclaim(text, next):           # waterfall 的监听器最后一个参数是 next
        return f"{await next()}!"

    ctx.on("greeting/format", exclaim)
    ctx.on("greeting/said", said.append)


shout = define_plugin(shout_apply)


class Events(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_plugins_hear_each_other(self):
        async def go():
            bus = Bus()                          # 同一个 bus 上的插件互相听得到
            async with load(greeter, bus=bus, id="greeter") as t, load(shout, bus=bus, id="shout"):
                self.assertEqual(await t.service("greeter").hello("Ada", "sv"), "Hej, Ada!")
                self.assertEqual(await t.service("greeter").hello("Bo", "en"), "Hello, Bo!")
                self.assertEqual(await t.serial("greeting/pick", "sv"), "Hej")  # 测试自己也能发出
                self.assertEqual(said, ["Ada", "Bo"])    # emit 经宿主，在它之后的 serial 回来时已送到

        asyncio.run(go())

"""greeter: a rutis plugin."""

# Guide: https://github.com/arcships/rutis/blob/main/docs/guide/python-plugin.en.md

from rutis import define_plugin


class Greeter:
    def __init__(self, greeting: str) -> None:
        self.greeting = greeting

    async def hello(self, name: str) -> str:
        return f"{self.greeting}, {name}!"


def apply(ctx, config):
    # config has the schema's default when the row leaves greeting out.
    ctx.provide("greeter", Greeter(config["greeting"]))


plugin = define_plugin(
    apply,
    # The services it uses (step 3 of the guide): inject=["translate"], then
    # ctx.use("translate") in apply.
    inject=[],
    # The services it provides, so a host knows them before the plugin runs:
    # the class's public methods.
    provides={"greeter": Greeter},
    # The JSON Schema of its config (step 4).
    config={"type": "object", "properties": {"greeting": {"type": "string", "default": "Hello"}}},
)

from rutis import define_plugin


class Greeter:
    def __init__(self, translate, greeting: str) -> None:
        self.translate = translate
        self.greeting = greeting

    async def hello(self, name: str) -> str:
        return f"{await self.translate.text(self.greeting)}, {name}!"


def apply(ctx, config):
    ctx.provide("greeter", Greeter(ctx.use("translate"), config["greeting"]))


plugin = define_plugin(
    apply,
    inject=["translate"],
    provides={"greeter": Greeter},
    config={"type": "object", "properties": {"greeting": {"type": "string", "default": "Hello"}}},
)

from rutis import define_plugin


class Greeter:
    def __init__(self, ctx, greeting: str) -> None:
        self.ctx = ctx
        self.translate = ctx.use("translate")
        self.greeting = greeting
        self.greeted = 0

    async def hello(self, name: str) -> str:
        word = await self.translate.text(self.greeting)
        self.ctx.emit("greeter/greeted", name)
        return f"{word}, {name}!"

    async def count(self) -> int:
        return self.greeted


def apply(ctx, config):
    greeter = Greeter(ctx, config["greeting"])

    def greeted(name):
        greeter.greeted += 1

    ctx.on("greeter/greeted", greeted)
    ctx.provide("greeter", greeter)


plugin = define_plugin(
    apply,
    inject=["translate"],
    provides={"greeter": Greeter},
    config={"type": "object", "properties": {"greeting": {"type": "string", "default": "Hello"}}},
)

import asyncio
import unittest

from rutis.testing import load

from greeter import plugin


class FakeTranslate:
    async def text(self, text: str) -> str:
        return {"Hello": "Bonjour", "Hi": "Salut"}.get(text, text)


class Plugin(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_greets_with_the_translated_greeting(self):
        async def go():
            async with load(plugin, config={"greeting": "Hi"}, services={"translate": FakeTranslate()}) as t:
                greeted = []
                t.on("greeter/greeted", greeted.append)
                self.assertEqual(await t.service("greeter").hello("Ada"), "Salut, Ada!")
                # The test can emit too; parallel waits for every listener, by then the emit before it has arrived
                await t.parallel("greeter/greeted", "Bo")
                self.assertEqual(greeted, ["Ada", "Bo"])
                self.assertEqual(await t.service("greeter").count(), 2)

        asyncio.run(go())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
